epic.title: Deficiency cleanup after epic #567
epic.intent_and_why: Reconcile observed defects with current code and complete bounded repairs before choosing the remaining one-spine architecture.

definition_of_done: Wave 1 bounded repairs are implemented and independently reviewed.
Wave 2 residual implementation and architecture evidence are ready at the human checkpoint.
Every observed defect and related open issue has an explicit disposition.

good_enough.mandatory_quality: Regression evidence at the public seam and independent review for every implementation lane.
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: Targeted tests plus the repository verification commands named by each Commander.
good_enough.appetite: Two bounded AFK waves ending before architecture selection or external publication.

hard_constraints: Do not mutate GitHub, push, open pull requests, merge to main, or choose an architecture before the checkpoint.
Preserve unrelated user changes in the main checkout.
Run #636 before #613 because both edit scripts/run_crew.py.
fixed_decisions: Route #639 into epic #572 and retain #575 as its Windows proof obligation.
Wave 1 contains #500, #636, and only the mechanical closeout half of #638.
Wave 2 may implement residual #613 and produce architecture evidence, but may not implement the architecture choice.

current_wave.objective: Complete the three independent bounded cleanup repairs approved for Wave 1.
exit_criteria: #500 proves refresh requests remain pending until a later claim and are consumed by same-session relaunch.
#636 proves concurrent registry mutations preserve every crew entry.
The mechanical #638 lane exposes the existing finish_work lifecycle through the MCP door and proves one-verb closeout.

issues.title: Consume a refresh request only after a later claim
issues.desired_outcome: Refresh request state is served and consumed by the next claim, including a same-session relaunch.
issues.useful_now: It closes the remaining live defect-ledger item around same-session relaunch.
issues.appetite: One bounded direct Implementer lane followed by an independent Reviewer.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: Targeted checklist-engine and governor tests demonstrate pending and consumed states.
issues.implementation_latitude: Choose local implementation details; preserve the confirmed DESIGN_500 behavior.
hard_constraints_no_gos: Do not widen refresh semantics beyond the settled design.
Do not edit unrelated workflow doctrine.
local_unknowns: Exact helper boundary for comparing the request stamp with the active claim.

issues.title: Make concurrent crew registry mutation lossless
issues.desired_outcome: Every concurrent registry update reloads current state under a lock and commits atomically by stable crew identity.
issues.useful_now: It removes the data-loss race before #613 changes the same launcher module.
issues.appetite: One bounded direct Implementer lane followed by an independent Reviewer.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: A multi-process regression fails on the old load-modify-save path and passes on the transactional path.
issues.implementation_latitude: Choose the lock and transaction helpers within scripts/run_crew.py and its tests.
hard_constraints_no_gos: Do not implement #613 in this lane.
Do not change external registry shape without evidence.
local_unknowns: Smallest cross-platform locking seam already supported by the repository.

issues.title: Expose one-verb mechanical finish_work closeout
issues.desired_outcome: The MCP door invokes the existing release-before-archive lifecycle and role instructions stop requiring the deadlocking manual sequence.
issues.useful_now: It closes the mechanical half of #638 without deciding parent authority or one-spine architecture.
issues.appetite: One bounded direct Implementer lane followed by an independent Reviewer.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: An end-to-end door test proves archive succeeds with no remaining active lease or binding.
issues.implementation_latitude: Wire the existing lifecycle through the MCP door and update only the instructions that expose mechanical closeout.
hard_constraints_no_gos: Do not absorb #632, #369, or other one-spine architecture work.
local_unknowns: Exact MCP tool name and minimal role-instruction surface that currently exposes the manual sequence.

wave_forecast.outcome: Implement residual #613, produce two architecture candidates, cold-critique them, and reconcile the remaining issue graph.
wave_forecast.why_likely: Wave 1 removes the run_crew overlap and leaves the architecture choice as the only deliberate human convergence point.
entry_conditions: All Wave 1 lanes are reviewed and integrated on the temporary epic branch.
The #636 result is the base for #613.
No Wave 1 evidence invalidates the mechanical/architecture split.

uncertainty_register.unknown: Whether one-spine elimination or explicit parent capability produces the smallest coherent architecture.
uncertainty_register.settle_by: Human convergence at the end-of-Wave-2 checkpoint.
uncertainty_register.current_evidence: The issue graph shows both duplicated state and missing authority as plausible roots.
uncertainty_register.next_probe: Produce two independent candidates and a cold critique against current code and map truth.

parked_possibilities: Implement #639 inside epic #572 after #575 supplies Windows proof.
Mutate GitHub issue scope and status after the human checkpoint.
Apply reusable doctrine lessons discovered during this epic.

completed_outcomes.outcome: Refresh requests are stamped at request time and consumed by the first later claim, including same-session relaunch, while legacy unstamped requests retain compatibility.
completed_outcomes.evidence: Commit 4999cf89 independently APPROVED and locally integrated at 159bd6bb.

completed_outcomes.outcome: Concurrent crew registry mutations are lock-scoped, reload current state, select seeded records by identity plus worktree, and commit atomically without losing another writer.
completed_outcomes.evidence: Repair commit 123f1674 independently APPROVED; 243 launcher tests and 20/20 spawned stress repetitions passed; locally integrated at d887e77d.

completed_outcomes.outcome: The MCP spine_close door invokes the existing finish_work lifecycle so normal closeout releases the parent and descendants, reaps bindings, and archives; readiness refusal preserves lifecycle state while emitting mandatory rejection telemetry.
completed_outcomes.evidence: Commits 7b55c477 and test-only 5891e80f independently APPROVED; all lifecycle, telemetry, installer, retirement, and adjacent adoption suites passed; locally integrated at d3d0c9ac.

wave_evidence.claim: All three Wave 1 lanes meet their independent review and integration boundary.
wave_evidence.expected: Each bounded change is approved and the combined isolated integration branch remains green.
wave_evidence.observed: Issues #500, #636, and mechanical #638 received fresh independent APPROVE verdicts. Integration commit d3d0c9ac passed 1352 tests, 3 skips, and 663 subtests plus template parsing and diff hygiene.
wave_evidence.source: .agent-work/20260820-deficiency-cleanup/ADMIRAL_LOG.md and the three issue reviewer results.

wave_evidence.claim: #636 is a valid foundation for residual #613.
wave_evidence.expected: Registry writes are transactional and target the intended worktree before launcher heartbeat ownership changes.
wave_evidence.observed: The repaired implementation preserves concurrent writers and same-session records from other worktrees; no #613 behavior was changed.

wave_evidence.claim: Mechanical #638 remains separated from the unresolved architecture decision.
wave_evidence.expected: One-verb closeout works without deciding parent authority or eliminating secondary plans.
wave_evidence.observed: Real JSON-RPC success and refusal pass. The production diff changes only the existing finish_work exposure and role instructions; the broader parent-authority half remains open for Wave 2 evidence.
